authors: Kakusaburo Onda, Eizo Sada, Takeshi Kobayashi, Shigeharu Kito, Kunimitsu Ito
journal: Journal of Chemical Engineering of Japan 3(1), 18-24
title: Salting-out parameters of gas solubility in aqueous salt solutions
experimental_method: Gas volumetric method: measured gas volume contacted with degassed salt solution in a thermostatted (+-0.01 C) apparatus with magnetic stirring; dissolved amount from the volume change, at about 1 atm and 25 C.
uncertainties_stated: Pure-water check: mean Bunsen coefficient 0.7595 (range +-0.17%) for CO2 and 0.1111 (range +-1.44%) for ethylene, six runs each, 25 C. No uncertainties for the table rows.
quality_remarks: Gas purity CO2 99.8%, C2H4 99.6%. Salt concentrations from weighing and checked by density or evaporation. Bunsen coefficient defined per cm3 of solution, gas volume reduced to 0 C, 760 mmHg with ideal gas law; 'at 0 C and 760 mmHg partial gas pressure'. Salt concentration is in mol/l (per litre of solution); Setschenow-type correlation uses ionic strength in mol/l. Table 3 (salting-out parameters) is fitted/derived, not extracted. Table 1 NH4NO3 rows 2.615 and 2.644 mol/l are near-replicates (alpha rises slightly, 0.6906 to 0.6917).
how_extracted: image_read (text layer present and matched; every cell read from the 200 dpi page image)
not_extracted_tables: Table 3 (calculated salting-out parameters xg, xc, xa and standard deviations): fitted/derived model parameters
